components.name: Service choice
components.description: A selectable form tile, rather than a decorative content card.
components.css: .ds-service{text-align:left;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;min-height:110px;padding:20px;background:transparent;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);border-radius:6px;color:#f4f3f0;cursor:pointer;font-family:'Manrope',sans-serif;transition:border-color .25s ease,background .25s ease,transform .2s ease}.ds-service-title{font:500 clamp(19px,2vw,23px)/1.1 'Syne',sans-serif;letter-spacing:-.01em}.ds-service-description{font:400 14px/1.45 'Manrope',sans-serif;color:rgba(244,243,240,.7)}.ds-service:hover{border-color:#c9a227;background:rgba(201,162,39,.07)}.ds-service:active{transform:scale(.985)}.ds-service[aria-pressed=true]{border-color:#c9a227;background:rgba(201,162,39,.13)}.ds-service:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #c9a227;outline-offset:3px}@media(max-width:520px){.ds-service{min-height:88px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-service{transition:none}}
